unverified_claims.note: This figure represents the estimated growth of the AI-specific earth observation sub-segment from 2021 to 2026. The AI Earth Monitoring market is cited as reaching $6.23B by 2028 at 20.6% CAGR (EIN Presswire). Extrapolating back to 2021 gives an approximate baseline of ~$1.0B, implying ~+300–400% growth by 2026. No single authoritative source provides a direct 2021 baseline figure for AI-specific EO. The broader Geospatial Intelligence market (MarketsandMarkets) grew at 11.1% CAGR; the AI sub-segment grew faster. The +390% figure is a directional estimate, not a primary-source-confirmed figure.

Planet Labs stock rose 16.1% in a single session after raising its 2026 revenue guidance. Quarterly revenue trajectory for Planet Labs implies ~28% sequential growth when annualized against the 65% YoY defense segment figure. No single source publishes a '3-month growth' figure for the broader geospatial AI market; this is a proxy derived from Planet Labs' guidance upgrade and the implicit quarterly run-rate.
